description: This file defines the RuleCreator class responsible for creating different rule objects based on the given type. It manages the creation of endpoint, error, and tree rules, throwing an exception if an unknown rule type is provided.

classes.name: RuleCreator
classes.description: A static factory class that creates and returns rule objects based on the specified type.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns an appropriate rule object ('EndpointRule', 'ErrorRule', 'TreeRule') based on the 'type' parameter; throws an exception if the type is unknown.
